title: Royal Perfume
description: The charming scent of royalty. May win some people's hearts.

title: Your Results
description: A constellation of metadata about you is stored here.

title: Duel Pistol
description: A jewel-studded ceremonial pistol, made for launching poetic duels.

title: Lethal Pistol
description: A river pirate has traded your ornamental pistol for a serious flintlock.

title: Gun Emoji
description: It's not a real gun, but some courts have ruled that gun emojis still constitute threats.

title: Strange Clock
description: A beautiful embellished clock with intricate parts designed in a Western pattern. It's in need of restoration.

title: Destiny Clock
description: A beautiful embellished clock. Turning its gears in the right location can allow you to change your astrological destiny...

title: Destiny Card
description: This magic card can enrich the present at the expense of the future.

title: Chicken Bone
description: It looks like it's the leg bone of a small chicken. It's a little crooked.

title: Saint's Bone
description: The chicken bone has been recognized by the Golden Church as a holy relic.

title: Sacred Tablet
description: It's a creepy glass tablet device. For some reason, you can't stop touching and checking it.

title: Blank Spellbook
description: A mysterious book given to you in a vision. It's entirely blank.

title: Red Spellbook
description: The book turned red when the acolyte marked it! You notice impressions of animals in the leather cover.

title: Celestial Spellbook
description: The All-Mother herself has marked your book. It's now dark, with a sun and moon design.

title: Red Plague
description: The kingdom is silently succumbing to the ravages of the Red Plague.

title: Partnership Monument
description: The Queen of the Northwest has promised you her support in a crisis.

title: Hall of Wonders
description: A priceless collection gathered by the Explorers Society. It's all in your honor.

title: Center for Philosophy
description: A widely-regarded hall of philosophical study and enlightenment.
